Coram: - Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Ambuj Nath

For the Petitioner: M/s. R. S. Mazumdar, Sr. Advocate For the State : M/s. Pankaj Kr. Mishra, A.P.P
---
02/09.01.2025 Heard the Parties.

Petitioner has been made an accused in connection with S. T. Case No. 227 of 2024, arising out of Godda (Town) P.S. Case No. 132 of 2024, Corresponding to G.R. Case No. 541 of 2024, for the offence registered under Sections 341, 323, 366, 376, 379, 504, 506 & 120B of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Godda.
The petitioner is alleged to have established consensual physical relationship with the prosecutrix who is a major lady.
Later on, the petitioner refused to marry her and demanded Rs.5 lakhs.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, the petitioner named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Twenty Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II, Godda in connection with S.T. Case No. 227 of 2024, arising out of Godda (Town) P.S. Case No. 132 of 2024,
Corresponding to G.R. Case No. 541 of 2024.
